scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.typecheck: node server/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node client/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test -- --run
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.qa:deps: node scripts/qa/run-local-tool.mjs dependency-cruiser depcruise server/src client/src --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs
scripts.qa:duplication: node scripts/qa/run-local-tool.mjs jscpd jscpd server/src client/src --config .jscpd.json
